review_result.summary: The code has several issues, including performance problems, potential security vulnerabilities, and missing documentation.

issues.description: The CSS styles are not separated from the HTML content. It's better to use an external stylesheet for better maintainability.
issues.suggestion: Move the CSS styles to an external stylesheet.

issues.description: The game board is redrawn every time the game state is updated. This can cause performance issues.
issues.suggestion: Only redraw the game board when necessary, such as when the snake moves or the food is spawned.

issues.description: The game uses the 'alert' function to display the game over message. This can be a security vulnerability if the game is played in a browser that allows JavaScript to access sensitive information.
issues.suggestion: Use a more secure way to display the game over message, such as using a HTML element to display the message.

issues.description: The game does not handle the case where the snake runs into the wall or itself. This can cause the game to crash.
issues.suggestion: Add a check to handle the case where the snake runs into the wall or itself, and end the game accordingly.

issues.description: The game logic is not separated from the rendering logic. This can make the code harder to maintain and understand.
issues.suggestion: Separate the game logic from the rendering logic into different functions or classes.
